content.title: 现在完成时的被动语态·has/have been + 过去分词 速查
content.intro: 当主语是动作的承受者、且动作'到现在已完成或有当前影响'时,用现在完成时的被动:has/have been + 过去分词。口诀:has/have + been + done。

rows: 主语 + has/have been + 过去分词:The software has been downloaded.
主语 + hasn't/haven't been + 过去分词:The file hasn't been copied yet.
Has/Have + 主语 + been + 过去分词?:Has the password been confirmed?
主语 + has/have been + done + by + 执行者:Jan's life has been improved by the Internet.

specialRules.rule: 单数主语(及不可数名词)用 has been done,复数及 I/you/we/they 用 have been done
specialRules.mark: The PC has been built. / Many people have been helped.

specialRules.rule: 主动变被动:主动宾语→被动主语,动词改 has/have been + 过去分词,执行者用 by 引出
specialRules.mark: They've built a new PC. → A new PC has been built (by them).

specialRules.rule: 时间副词 already/just 放 been 前,yet 放句末(多用于否定/疑问)
specialRules.mark: has already been done / hasn't been done yet

specialRules.rule: 疑问句把 has/have 提到主语前,过去分词不变
specialRules.mark: Has anyone made a comment? → Has a comment been made?

why: 被动语态把'谁承受动作'放在主语位置;再叠加现在完成时的'have/has + 过去分词',就得到 has/have been + 过去分词——既表被动,又表'到现在已完成'。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/改错高频:看主语是不是动作承受者,是→用被动;再判断'已完成'语境(already/yet/just/since/recently)→现在完成时被动。
主谓一致:被动主语决定 has 还是 have,与执行者(by 后)无关。

examVsReal.exam: The software has been downloaded.（考试/书面规范）
examVsReal.real: The software's downloaded. / It's all set up.
examVsReal.note: 口语常缩写 has→'s,或用 be done/be all set 等更简洁的说法

examVsReal.exam: Has the password been confirmed?（考试)
examVsReal.real: Did you confirm the password? / Is the password set?
examVsReal.note: 日常口语里常用主动一般过去时或 be done 提问,语义相近
